Hi Tanya / Mike,

Thanks again for a productive kickoff earlier today. Attached is a first-pass "Shared Success Timeline" (Sable_MAP_v1.xlsx) plus a compact cutover playbook to use for internal sign-offs. I pulled together a conservative timeline that balances Sable's requested go-live window with typical integration tasks we see across similar healthcare deployments.

High-level asks from our side:
- Can you confirm internal approvers for the 3 acceptance gates listed (Security, Data Contract, UAT)?
- Any blackout dates in April/May we should avoid for cutovers?
- Please review milestone owners column and flag edits — we assumed Sable will own data mapping and Redwood will own model onboarding and the staging environment.

Key milestones (excerpt):
1) Security questionnaires complete — target 2029-04-19 — owner: Sable (Tanya) / Redwood (Olga)
2) Data ingest spec finalized — target 2029-04-24 — owner: Sable (Mike)
3) Sandbox model validation (3 sample workflows) — target 2029-05-03 — owner: Redwood (Ben)
4) UAT window 1 start — target 2029-05-13 — owner: Sable
5) Go-live (soft) — target 2029-05-28 — owner: joint

Notes: acceptance criteria are included in the attached worksheet (column H). We kept the timeline intentionally conservative — if you want to compress we can re-run resource checks and propose an accelerated plan.

I'll follow up later this week with a short mutual action plan (MAP) email that calls out dependent tasks and exact SLAs for the sandbox tests.
